instruction: Look up the top open issue in "microsoft/vscode" and write the following details to "$HOME/Desktop/gh_issue_detail_5_3.txt": issue_number, title, state, author_login, labels. You may use any clear text format. If any requested field is empty or missing, write it as "none". Should no open issue exist, save an empty file instead.
reference_command:
gh issue list --repo microsoft/vscode --state open --limit 1 --json number,title,state,author,labels --jq '.[0] | "issue_number: #\(.number)
title: \(.title)
state: \(.state)
author_login: \(.author.login)
labels: \(([.labels[].name] | if length == 0 then "none" else join(",") end))"' > "$HOME/Desktop/gh_issue_detail_5_3.txt"
